settings.title: You're Not Too Old to Fix This—And Here's Why
settings.text:
Many men believe that once bladder leaks start, there's no way to reverse them. But that's simply not true.

Your pelvic floor is a muscle—and like any muscle, it can be strengthened at any age.

Studies show that men in their 40s to 90s can regain bladder control by activating and strengthening these muscles properly.

Most men struggle to perform pelvic floor exercises correctly. They squeeze the wrong muscles, forget to stay consistent, and then give up when they don't see results.

The good news? It's not too late to stop the cycle.

settings.text:
Men who leak urine are more likely to fall — especially at night.
